Container.Name: storytime
Container.Overview: StoryTime: write branching, choose-your-own-adventure stories together, with optional AI help. Everyone brings their own AI key (kept in their browser), so the server needs no AI credentials. Stories are stored in a single SQLite file in the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the site is served on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where the database lives. Include this folder in your appdata backups.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Turns on the /admin moderation page. Leave blank to switch it off.
